text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Second track: generative models, which learn the whole cloud, not just its middle. Adversarial networks first, then diffusion, then flow matching, the family the study used. They now dream three-dimensional turbulence, global weather ensembles, and steady turbulent states for chosen settings.
